title: Mark Chapter 5 Quiz - Multi-Level
description: An enhanced quiz on Mark chapter 5 with Easy, Medium, Hard, and Theological levels. Each level has 15 carefully crafted questions. Choose your difficulty and dive in!

easy.title: Mark Chapter 5 Quiz - Easy Level
easy.description: Perfect for beginners! Test your basic knowledge of Mark Chapter 5.

questions.question: In Mark 5, which of the following appears FIRST in the chapter?
options: A man with an unclean spirit meets Jesus
Jesus comes over to the country of the Gadarenes
The unclean spirits enter the swine
The man with the legion sits clothed and in his right mind
questions.correctAnswer: Jesus comes over to the country of the Gadarenes
questions.explanation: Mark 5:1 states that Jesus and his group came over unto the other side of the sea, into the country of the Gadarenes, which is the first event mentioned in the chapter.

questions.question: Where did Jesus and his group come to in Mark 5?
questions.explanation: Mark 5:1 says they came over unto the other side of the sea, into the country of the Gadarenes.

questions.question: What immediately met Jesus when he came out of the ship?
options: A man with an unclean spirit
questions.correctAnswer: A man with an unclean spirit
questions.explanation: Mark 5:2 states that immediately there met him out of the tombs a man with an unclean spirit.

questions.question: Where did the man with the unclean spirit dwell?
questions.explanation: Mark 5:3 says the man had his dwelling among the tombs.

questions.question: What was impossible to do to the man with the unclean spirit?
questions.explanation: Mark 5:3 states that no man could bind him, no, not with chains.

questions.question: What did the man with the unclean spirit do night and day?
options: He was in the mountains and tombs, crying and cutting himself with stones
questions.correctAnswer: He was in the mountains and tombs, crying and cutting himself with stones
questions.explanation: Mark 5:5 describes that night and day he was in the mountains and tombs, crying and cutting himself with stones.

questions.question: What did the man with the unclean spirit do when he saw Jesus from afar?
questions.explanation: Mark 5:6 states that when he saw Jesus afar off, he ran and worshipped him.

questions.question: What did the unclean spirit say to Jesus?
options: What have I to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of the most high God?
questions.correctAnswer: What have I to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of the most high God?
questions.explanation: Mark 5:7 records the spirit crying with a loud voice saying, 'What have I to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of the most high God?'

questions.question: What name did the man with the unclean spirit give when asked?
questions.explanation: Mark 5:9 states that the man answered, 'My name is Legion: for we are many.'

questions.question: What did the unclean spirits request Jesus to do instead of sending them away out of the country?
questions.explanation: Mark 5:12 records the devils asking Jesus to send them into the swine so they might enter them.

questions.question: How many swine were in the herd mentioned in Mark 5?
questions.explanation: Mark 5:13 says the herd ran violently down the steep place into the sea and were about two thousand.

questions.question: True or False: The man with the legion was found sitting, clothed, and in his right mind after Jesus healed him.
questions.explanation: Mark 5:15 states the man who was possessed with the devil and had the legion was sitting, clothed, and in his right mind.

questions.question: True or False: The devils begged Jesus not to send them into the swine.
questions.explanation: Mark 5:12 shows the devils begged Jesus to send them into the swine, not the opposite.

questions.question: True or False: The herdsmen fled and told the city and country about what had happened to the swine.
questions.explanation: Mark 5:14 says those that fed the swine fled and told it in the city and country.

questions.question: True or False: The unclean spirit said, 'Come into me, Jesus, Son of God.'
questions.explanation: There is no verse in Mark 5 that records the unclean spirit saying 'Come into me, Jesus, Son of God.' The spirit asked Jesus not to torment him and gave its name as Legion (Mark 5:7-9).

medium.title: Mark Chapter 5 Quiz - Medium Level
medium.description: Ready for more? Apply biblical truths from Mark Chapter 5 to real-life situations.

questions.question: What did the people request after seeing what happened to the man possessed with the devil and the swine?
options: They began to pray Jesus to depart out of their coasts
They asked Jesus to heal more people
They wanted Jesus to stay longer
questions.correctAnswer: They began to pray Jesus to depart out of their coasts
questions.explanation: Mark 5:17 states that they began to pray him to depart out of their coasts after seeing what befell the possessed man and the swine.

questions.question: What does Mark 5:20 promise will happen if someone tells their friends how great things the Lord has done for them, as instructed in Mark 5:19?
questions.explanation: Mark 5:20 shows the man publishing how great things Jesus had done for him and that all men did marvel, following Jesus' instruction in Mark 5:19 to tell his friends.

questions.question: Who came to Jesus begging Him to heal his dying daughter?
options: Jairus, one of the rulers of the synagogue
A certain woman with an issue of blood
The man possessed with the devil
questions.correctAnswer: Jairus, one of the rulers of the synagogue
questions.explanation: Mark 5:22 identifies Jairus, a ruler of the synagogue, who came to Jesus and beseeched Him to heal his daughter.

questions.question: How did the woman with an issue of blood demonstrate her faith according to Mark 5:27-28 and what was the result described in Mark 5:29?
options: She touched Jesus' garment and was immediately healed
She prayed loudly and was ignored
She gave money and was blessed
She followed Jesus but remained sick
questions.correctAnswer: She touched Jesus' garment and was immediately healed
questions.explanation: Mark 5:27-28 tells how the woman touched Jesus' garment in faith that she would be healed, and Mark 5:29 confirms that she was immediately healed.

questions.question: What does Jesus instruct the healed man to do instead of following him in the ship?
options: Go home to thy friends and tell them what the Lord hath done
questions.correctAnswer: Go home to thy friends and tell them what the Lord hath done
questions.explanation: Mark 5:19 records Jesus telling the healed man not to follow Him but to go home and tell his friends about the great things the Lord has done.

questions.question: What was the condition of the woman who had the issue of blood before she touched Jesus' garment?
options: She had suffered many things of many physicians and was nothing bettered
She was a servant in the synagogue
She was a friend of Jairus
questions.correctAnswer: She had suffered many things of many physicians and was nothing bettered
questions.explanation: Mark 5:26 explains she had suffered much under many physicians and was not improved but rather had gotten worse.

questions.question: Where was Jesus when the crowd gathered to Him before Jairus came to Him?
questions.explanation: Mark 5:21 states that Jesus was nigh unto the sea when much people gathered unto Him.

questions.question: What did Jesus immediately perceive when the woman touched His clothes?
options: That virtue had gone out of him
That no one had touched Him
questions.correctAnswer: That virtue had gone out of him
questions.explanation: Mark 5:30 says Jesus immediately knew that virtue had gone out of Him when the woman touched His clothes.

questions.question: What attitude did the man possessed with the devil show toward Jesus when he first saw Him from afar?
questions.explanation: Mark 5:6 shows the man ran and worshipped Jesus when he saw Him from afar.

questions.question: Why did the unclean spirits beg Jesus not to send them away out of the country?
options: Because they wanted to enter into the herd of swine
Because they wanted to stay in the man forever
Because they wanted to possess another person
questions.correctAnswer: Because they wanted to enter into the herd of swine
questions.explanation: Mark 5:10-12 shows the devils begged Jesus to send them into the swine rather than be sent away out of the country.

questions.question: What was the reaction of the people after seeing the man who was possessed with the legion sitting, clothed, and in his right mind?
questions.explanation: Mark 5:15 states that when they saw the man sitting, clothed, and in his right mind, they were afraid.

questions.question: What does the story of the woman with the issue of blood teach about faith and persistence in seeking Jesus?
options: Faith and persistence lead to healing even after long suffering
Healing is always instant without faith
questions.correctAnswer: Faith and persistence lead to healing even after long suffering
questions.explanation: The woman had suffered twelve years and was not healed by physicians but was healed by persistent faith as she touched Jesus’ garment (Mark 5:25-29).

questions.question: What practical lesson can be learned from Jesus’ instruction to the healed man to tell his friends about the Lord's compassion?
options: Sharing testimony encourages others to believe
Only priests should speak of miracles
questions.correctAnswer: Sharing testimony encourages others to believe
questions.explanation: Jesus told the healed man to go and tell his friends how great things the Lord had done, highlighting the importance of sharing faith experiences (Mark 5:19).

questions.question: Jesus allowed the unclean spirits to enter the swine. What was the immediate consequence of this action?
options: The herd ran violently down a steep place into the sea and were choked
The swine became healthy and multiplied
The swine fled into the city
questions.correctAnswer: The herd ran violently down a steep place into the sea and were choked
questions.explanation: Mark 5:13 describes how the unclean spirits entered the swine, which then ran violently into the sea and drowned.

questions.question: True or False: The healed man with the legion asked Jesus to let him stay with Him when Jesus got into the ship.
questions.explanation: Mark 5:18 records that the man who had been possessed prayed Jesus that he might be with him when Jesus got into the ship.

hard.title: Mark Chapter 5 Quiz - Hard Level
hard.description: Challenge yourself with deep analysis and cross-biblical connections from Mark Chapter 5.

questions.question: What did the disciples say to Jesus when he asked, 'Who touched me?'
options: Thou seest the multitude thronging thee
questions.correctAnswer: Thou seest the multitude thronging thee
questions.explanation: This is found in Mark 5:31, where the disciples point out the crowd surrounding Jesus, making his question seem puzzling.

questions.question: What was the woman's condition before she touched Jesus?
options: She had an issue of blood for twelve years
questions.correctAnswer: She had an issue of blood for twelve years
questions.explanation: In Mark 5:25, it is stated that a certain woman had an issue of blood for twelve years, highlighting her suffering before she approached Jesus.

questions.question: What did Jesus say to the woman who touched his garment?
options: Your faith has made you whole
You are healed from your disease
questions.correctAnswer: Your faith has made you whole
questions.explanation: This is clearly stated in Mark 5:34, where Jesus confirms that her faith is the reason for her healing.

questions.question: What was the message brought to Jairus from his house?
questions.explanation: In Mark 5:35, it is reported that Jairus' daughter has died, advising him not to trouble Jesus any further.

questions.question: What did Jesus tell Jairus when he heard the news about his daughter?
questions.explanation: This encouragement is given in Mark 5:36, where Jesus reassures Jairus amidst the distressing news.

questions.question: What did Jesus call the young girl when he raised her?
questions.explanation: In Mark 5:41, Jesus addresses the girl with the Aramaic phrase 'Talitha cumi', meaning 'Damsel, I say unto thee, arise.'

questions.question: What does the Greek word 'plague' in Mark 5:34 mean?
questions.explanation: The term 'plague' refers to a state of affliction or suffering, indicating the woman's long-term suffering before her healing.

questions.question: What literary device is used in Mark 5:39 where Jesus states the girl is not dead but sleepeth?
questions.explanation: Jesus uses a metaphor in Mark 5:39 to describe death as sleep, conveying hope and the idea of resurrection.

questions.question: Which other Bible passage connects to the theme of faith leading to healing in Mark 5:34?
questions.explanation: Matthew 9:22 echoes this theme where Jesus tells the woman her faith has healed her, correlating with Mark 5:34.

questions.question: Which other Bible passage connects to the resurrection theme in Mark 5:41?
questions.explanation: John 11:43, where Jesus calls Lazarus forth from the dead, parallels Mark 5:41 in demonstrating Jesus' power over death.

questions.question: What comes before Jesus' statement in Mark 5:39?
options: He charges the woman to keep silent
questions.explanation: Mark 5:38 indicates that Jesus first arrives at the house before addressing the mourners in verse 39.

questions.question: What is the significance of the number twelve in Mark 5?
questions.explanation: The number twelve appears in both the girl's age and the duration of the woman's issue, symbolic in Jewish tradition for completeness.

questions.question: Jesus commanded silence about his miracles. This is an example of what?
questions.explanation: This theme of silence regarding his miracles, as seen in Mark 5:43, is known as the Messianic secret, emphasizing Jesus' identity.

questions.question: Is it true that Jesus raised a girl from the dead in Mark 5?
questions.explanation: This event is recorded in Mark 5:41-42, where Jesus raises Jairus' daughter from the dead.

questions.question: Is it false that the woman with the issue of blood was healed by touching Jesus' garment?
questions.explanation: The woman was indeed healed by touching Jesus' garment, as stated in Mark 5:29, making this statement false.

theological.title: Mark Chapter 5 Quiz - Theological Level
theological.description: Deep biblical theology from Mark Chapter 5 that unites all believers. Explore foundational truths about God, creation, and humanity.

questions.question: What doctrine does Mark 5:3 teach about human sin and spiritual bondage?
options: Human sin can result in destructive spiritual captivity that resists human control
Human sin is primarily a legal issue resolved by ritual purification
Human sin is only a physical ailment with no spiritual consequences
Human sin is easily overcome by human effort and willpower
questions.correctAnswer: Human sin can result in destructive spiritual captivity that resists human control
questions.explanation: Mark 5:3 describes the man who had his dwelling among the tombs and could not be bound even with chains, illustrating the depth of his spiritual bondage due to sin.

questions.question: What doctrine about Christ's authority over evil spirits is taught in Mark 5:8?
options: Christ has sovereign authority to command unclean spirits to depart
Christ negotiates with evil spirits for temporary relief
Christ is powerless over spiritual forces
Christ requires human cooperation to bind evil spirits
questions.correctAnswer: Christ has sovereign authority to command unclean spirits to depart
questions.explanation: In Mark 5:8, Jesus commands the unclean spirit to come out of the man, demonstrating his divine authority over demonic forces.

questions.question: What doctrine does Mark 5:20 teach about the role of testimony in the Christian life?
options: Believers are called to proclaim the works of God publicly
Believers should keep their experiences of God private
Testimony is unnecessary for faith to grow
Only clergy are authorized to share testimonies
questions.correctAnswer: Believers are called to proclaim the works of God publicly
questions.explanation: Mark 5:20 shows the healed man beginning to publish how great things Jesus had done for him, illustrating the doctrine of public witness as part of sanctification.

questions.question: Which divine attribute does Mark 5:30 specifically demonstrate?
questions.explanation: In Mark 5:30 Jesus immediately knows that virtue had gone out of him and asks who touched him, demonstrating his omniscience.

questions.question: Which divine attribute does Mark 5:19 specifically demonstrate?
questions.explanation: Mark 5:19 records Jesus showing compassion by instructing the healed man to go and tell how the Lord had compassion on him.

questions.question: How does the healing of the demoniac in Mark 5 prepare for the ultimate victory over evil in Revelation?
options: It foreshadows Christ's final defeat of Satan and liberation of his people
It shows that evil spirits will always remain victorious on earth
It depicts a temporary truce between good and evil
It illustrates that evil spirits are stronger than humans
questions.correctAnswer: It foreshadows Christ's final defeat of Satan and liberation of his people
questions.explanation: Mark 5’s account of Jesus casting out Legion anticipates the ultimate eschatological defeat of Satan described in Revelation 20:10.

questions.question: What redemptive-historical connection does the raising of Jairus' daughter in Mark 5:41-42 have with Old Testament resurrection motifs?
options: It prefigures the resurrection power revealed fully in Christ
It contradicts Old Testament teaching on death
It shows that resurrection was only possible through magical incantations
It denies any continuity with Israel’s hope in life after death
questions.correctAnswer: It prefigures the resurrection power revealed fully in Christ
questions.explanation: The raising of Jairus’ daughter in Mark 5:41-42 prefigures the ultimate resurrection and life that Jesus brings, consistent with Old Testament hope (e.g., Ezekiel 37).

questions.question: What combined doctrine do verses Mark 5:6 and Mark 5:7 teach about Jesus' identity and the recognition of evil spirits?
options: Evil spirits recognize Jesus as the Son of God and submit to His authority
Evil spirits deny Jesus' deity and refuse to acknowledge Him
Jesus is unaware of the presence of evil spirits
Evil spirits have power equal to Jesus
questions.correctAnswer: Evil spirits recognize Jesus as the Son of God and submit to His authority
questions.explanation: Mark 5:6-7 show the unclean spirit recognizing Jesus as 'Son of the most high God' and worshipping Him, indicating acknowledgment of His divine identity and authority.

questions.question: What combined doctrine do Mark 5:34 and Mark 5:29 teach about faith and healing?
options: Faith is the instrumental cause through which God's healing power is received
Healing is automatic and independent of faith
Faith works by human effort alone without divine power
Only physical remedies bring about healing
questions.correctAnswer: Faith is the instrumental cause through which God's healing power is received
questions.explanation: Mark 5:29 describes the woman's healing, and Jesus in 5:34 attributes her healing to her faith, showing faith as the means of receiving divine healing.

questions.question: What combined doctrine do Mark 5:36 and Mark 5:39 teach about the nature of death and resurrection?
options: Death is temporary like sleep for those in Christ, anticipating resurrection
Resurrection is impossible and only spiritual
questions.correctAnswer: Death is temporary like sleep for those in Christ, anticipating resurrection
questions.explanation: Jesus tells Jairus 'the damsel is not dead, but sleepeth' (Mark 5:39), encouraging belief in resurrection power (Mark 5:36).

questions.question: Sceptics claim that Jesus' allowing demons to enter the swine (Mark 5:12-13) shows irresponsibility and cruelty. What does Mark 5:12-13 actually teach?
options: Jesus exercises sovereign judgment over evil spirits, illustrating His authority and the destructive nature of demons
Jesus is indifferent to the suffering of animals
Jesus is powerless and must obey the demons' requests
The swine incident is a myth with no theological meaning
questions.correctAnswer: Jesus exercises sovereign judgment over evil spirits, illustrating His authority and the destructive nature of demons
questions.explanation: Mark 5:12-13 shows Jesus granting permission to demons to enter the swine, demonstrating his authority over them and highlighting the destructive nature of evil.

questions.question: What doctrine does Mark 5:25-26 teach about human suffering and the limits of human means?
options: Human suffering often persists despite medical intervention, pointing to the need for divine healing
Human suffering is always cured by physicians
Suffering is a sign of divine punishment without remedy
Medical help can replace faith in God
questions.correctAnswer: Human suffering often persists despite medical intervention, pointing to the need for divine healing
questions.explanation: Mark 5:25-26 describes the woman who suffered for twelve years and was not helped by many physicians, indicating limitations of human efforts.

questions.question: Which divine attribute does Mark 5:36 specifically demonstrate when Jesus tells Jairus 'Be not afraid, only believe'?
questions.explanation: Jesus' command to Jairus in Mark 5:36 reflects His sovereign power over life and death, calling for faith instead of fear.

questions.question: What redemptive-historical connection does the woman healed from the issue of blood in Mark 5:28-34 illustrate?
options: The inclusion of Gentiles and outcasts into the kingdom through faith
The rejection of healing by faith
The primacy of ritual law over faith
The limitation of Jesus' power to Israel
questions.correctAnswer: The inclusion of Gentiles and outcasts into the kingdom through faith
questions.explanation: The woman, who was ceremonially unclean, is healed by faith, prefiguring the kingdom's openness to all who believe.

questions.question: What combined doctrine do Mark 5:21-24 and Mark 5:37-43 teach about Jesus' ministry and the role of faith under trial?
options: Jesus calls disciples to trust Him even when circumstances appear hopeless
Faith is unnecessary when Jesus is present
Faith depends on visible miracles only
questions.correctAnswer: Jesus calls disciples to trust Him even when circumstances appear hopeless
questions.explanation: The narrative arc from Jairus' request to the raising of his daughter illustrates Jesus calling for faith amidst apparent death and despair.
